narrative: Market Narrative: Positive sentiment in the market has been driven by robust earnings from Wynn Resorts, Jacobs Engineering, and OpenAI. Despite some softness in AI hardware stocks due to US import bans, overall market performance continues to thrive. With the US stocks reaching new highs, supported by rising profits and easing oil prices, the current trend remains bullish. However, the global economy faces headwind from ongoing geopolitical tensions in Ukraine and a lingering antisemitism issue in Canada.
